# pangolin_domain (Resource)

Manages a domain attached to a Pangolin organization. type and base_domain are immutable after creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_domain" "example" {
  org_id      = pangolin_organization.example.org_id
  type        = "wildcard"
  base_domain = "apps.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_domain` (String) The base domain to attach.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID this domain belongs to.
- `type` (String) One of ns, cname, or wildcard. Self-hosted (OSS) instances only support wildcard.

### Optional

- `cert_resolver` (String) Certificate resolver to use for this domain.
- `prefer_wildcard_cert` (Boolean) Whether to prefer a wildcard certificate for this domain.

### Read-Only

- `domain_id` (String) Server-generated domain ID.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the domain has completed verification.
